prohibited.label: Uses subliminal or manipulative techniques likely to cause harm
Exploits vulnerabilities of children, elderly people, or people with disabilities
Performs social scoring of individuals on behalf of a public authority
Performs real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement
Infers race, political opinion, religion, or sexual orientation from biometric data
Infers emotions in the workplace or in education settings
Predicts the likelihood of someone committing a crime based solely on profiling
Scrapes facial images from the internet or CCTV to build or expand a recognition database

safetyComponent.label: Is this system a safety component of a product already regulated under EU law? (e.g. medical devices, machinery, vehicles, aviation, toys, lifts)

domains.label: Critical infrastructure (water, power, gas, traffic, digital infrastructure)
Employment or worker management (hiring, monitoring, promotion, termination)
Access to essential services (credit, insurance, public benefits)

carveoutNarrowTask.label: Does the system only perform a narrow procedural task, or check/verify a decision a human already made?

carveoutProfiling.label: Does the system profile individuals — e.g. build behavioral, preference, or risk profiles about specific people?

transparency.label: Acts as a chatbot or conversational AI interacting with people
Generates or manipulates synthetic images, audio, or video (deepfakes)
Generates text published to inform the public on matters of public interest
Performs emotion recognition or biometric categorization not covered above
